description: Fresh setup with no existing profile — should run full interview flow
expected_behavior: Asks name, field, current role, target role, target level
Creates ~/Documents/career-toolkit/ with drafts/ and research/ subdirs
Creates profile.md in workspace
Creates ~/.claude/career-toolkit.local.md with YAML frontmatter
Offers resume ingestion (PDF or paste)
Offers to run resume-review or resume-research after completion

prompt: set up my profile. My name is Alex, I'm a nurse. Here's my resume: [paste resume text]
description: Setup with inline resume paste — should parse resume without asking for PDF
expected_behavior: Parses pasted resume text into resume.md
Does NOT ask user to drop a PDF since text was already provided
Creates profile with field=nursing
Offers immediate resume review

description: Setup when profile already exists — should offer update vs fresh start
expected_behavior: Detects existing profile
Shows summary of current profile data
Offers to update or start fresh
Does NOT overwrite without user confirmation

prompt: /career-toolkit:setup (user answers 'I'm not sure yet' to target role)
description: User doesn't know their target role — should handle gracefully
expected_behavior: Records 'exploring' in profile
Does NOT pressure user to pick a role
Completes setup successfully
Other skills handle 'exploring' gracefully

prompt: /career-toolkit:setup (user says 'I'm a nurse' or 'I'm in marketing')
description: Non-tech field — no SWE jargon should appear
expected_behavior: No SWE jargon in interview questions
Level framing uses field-appropriate terms (not IC4/IC5/Staff)
Profile captures field correctly
No references to engineering, code, or tech-specific concepts
